test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who was recognised as ‘Asthana Nartaki’ (resident dancer) of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yamini Krishnamurthy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mungara Yamini Krishnamurthy **is an **Indian dancer **of **Bharatanatyam **and **Kuchipudi styles of dancing**.
 
• She was **born **on **20 December 1940, Madanapalle**.
 
• She was **awarded Padma Vibhushan**, **Padma Bhushan**, and **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for Dance - Bharatanatyam**.
 
• She has the **honour of being Asthana Nartaki (resident dancer) **of the **Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chinta **Ravi Bala Krishna is **a winner **of the **Sangeet Natak Akademi’s Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar for 2009**, a recipient of the singular honor of **Yuva Sutradhari **at the **Siddhendra Yogi Nrityotsav in 2007**, **a Gold Medallist M.A Kuchipudi, **as well as being **a winner of a host of other awards**.
 
• **Pandit Sunder Prasad **was a **guru of - Jaipur Gharana **of the **Indian classical dance **form, **Kathak**. He received his **training **from his **father Pandit Chunnilal of Jaipur Gharana**.
 
• **Mohanrao Shankarrao Kallianpurkar **was **a Kathak dancer **and **teacher from Karnataka**, considered to be one of the **greatest scholars and teachers **of the **Kathak **dance form. He **belongs **to the **Jaipur school of Kathak**.
